soluciones.title: Four lines that amplify each other
soluciones.description: We combine professional services, data distribution, and leading platforms to deliver end-to-end geospatial intelligence for energy, infrastructure, agribusiness, and defense.
soluciones.hero_sub: An integrated ecosystem where each line amplifies the value of the others.

arcgis.label: Esri · ArcGIS
arcgis.title: ArcGIS Enterprise — configuration, development & administration
arcgis.description: We implement, customize, and operate ArcGIS Enterprise for organizations that need a robust, secure, and scalable GIS platform within their own environments.
arcgis.f1: ArcGIS Enterprise implementation and configuration on-premise or private cloud
arcgis.f2: Web and mobile application development on the Esri platform
arcgis.f3: Continuous administration, monitoring, and version upgrades
arcgis.f4: Integration with ERP, EAM, and SCADA corporate systems

vantor.label: Vantor
vantor.title: Subscription and on-demand geospatial solutions
vantor.description: We distribute the Vantor portfolio: flexible access to GIS tools, data, and capabilities through subscription or on-demand models tailored to your business cycle.
vantor.f1: Monthly or annual subscription access to the Vantor portfolio
vantor.f2: On-demand purchase of specific tools and datasets
vantor.f3: Flexible licensing adapted to budget cycles
vantor.f5: Coverage for Colombia and Latin America

syspective.label: Syspective
syspective.title: SAR imagery as a service — continuous monitoring from space
syspective.description: We distribute the Syspective (Japan) SAR constellation in DaaS mode: synthetic aperture radar data for change detection, subsidence, soil moisture, and ground movement — through clouds, day or night.
syspective.f1: SAR data in DaaS mode: on-demand or subscription delivery
syspective.f2: Surface change detection with day-scale revisit
syspective.f3: Subsidence and ground deformation monitoring (mm precision)
syspective.f4: Soil moisture analysis for agribusiness and environment
syspective.f5: 24/7 operation: penetrates clouds, works at night

vertigis.label: VertiGIS
vertigis.title: VertiGIS Studio & Neo — vertical solutions on ArcGIS
vertigis.description: We extend ArcGIS with the VertiGIS suite: Studio for no-code app configuration and Neo for inspection, maintenance, and asset management workflows in the field.
vertigis.f1: VertiGIS Studio: no-code GIS app configuration on ArcGIS
vertigis.f2: VertiGIS Neo: field inspection, maintenance, and asset management
vertigis.f3: Work orders, routes, and offline-first reports
vertigis.f4: Sectors: Oil & Gas, utilities, infrastructure, transport
vertigis.f5: Native integration with ArcGIS Enterprise and ArcGIS Online

soluciones.integracion_sub: ArcGIS Enterprise is the core. Vantor extends capabilities. Syspective feeds it with satellite data. VertiGIS extends to the field. Together they form complete geospatial intelligence.
soluciones.int_r1_desc: ArcGIS Enterprise as the core of the corporate GIS infrastructure.
soluciones.int_r2_desc: Vantor extends capabilities with flexible access to data and software.
soluciones.int_r3_desc: Syspective feeds the ecosystem with high-resolution SAR data.
soluciones.int_r4_desc: VertiGIS brings ArcGIS to inspection, maintenance, and field assets.
soluciones.cta_sub: Tell us the challenge and we design the combination of lines your organization needs.

antesdespues.title: Measurable results that transform territories and decisions

nosotros.hero_sub: We combine technology, expertise, and strategic partnerships to transform territorial data into decisions that move organizations.
nosotros.about_title: A decade transforming territories with data
nosotros.about_p1: DreamGIS was born in Bogotá with a conviction: geospatial data is the intelligence layer missing from the strategic decisions of large organizations. With over ten years of experience, we have consolidated a portfolio of four complementary lines that allow our clients to see, understand, and act on their territories with precision.
nosotros.about_p2: Today we operate in sectors of high territorial complexity —energy, infrastructure, agribusiness, and defense— and are reference partners in the distribution and administration of the most robust geospatial platforms on the market.
nosotros.mision_text: Transform geospatial data into strategic decisions for organizations operating in complex territories, through cutting-edge technology, specialized talent, and world-class partnerships.
nosotros.vision_text: To be the regional reference for enterprise geospatial intelligence in Latin America by 2030, where every DreamGIS project contributes to sustainable development and informed decision-making about the territory.
nosotros.valores_title: The principles that guide every project
nosotros.v1_desc: Every implementation, every data layer, every line of code reflects the technical rigor our clients expect from a world-class geospatial partner.
nosotros.v2_desc: We don't deliver software: we deliver decision-making capability. A project's success is measured by the impact it generates on the territory and the business.
nosotros.v3_desc: We build long-term relationships. We are the partner that stays when complexity increases and decisions become more critical.
nosotros.v4_desc: SAR data, no-code platforms, and AI are redefining geospatial intelligence. We stay ahead of those changes so our clients always have the best tool.
nosotros.equipo_sub: Engineers, analysts, and GIS architects with experience in high-complexity projects for the most demanding sectors in Latin America.
nosotros.clientes_title: Organizations that trust our geospatial intelligence
nosotros.cta_sub: Tell us the challenge and we'll find the geospatial solution you need.

contacto.hero_sub: Tell us the challenge and a DreamGIS specialist will get in touch with you within 24 hours.
